items.text: [p align="justify"]We have some good news for all the achievement hunters among you!
[p align="justify"]Steam has recently introduced a new Achievement Sets feature, and we've already implemented it in Crime Scene Cleaner.
[p align="justify"]From now on, our Steam achievements are organized into separate sets, between the Base Game, Nightmare Levels and Act 2.

notes.title: What does this mean for you?

items.text: [p align="justify"]Most importantly, completing the base game can now stand on its own. New achievements added alongside additional content won't have to take away the completion you've already earned in the base game.

[p align="justify"]This is especially important to us with Biohazard DLC on the horizon. We want to be able to give you new achievements and challenges to hunt down as we add new content, without making completionists feel like their previous 100% suddenly doesn't count anymore.
[p align="justify"]Each Achievement Set also has its own progress, making it easier to see what you've completed and what you still have left to clean up.

[p align="justify"]One important thing to keep in mind: Achievement Sets are currently still a Steam Beta feature, so for now you'll need to be using the Steam Client Beta to see the new system in action fully. Additional information about these changes you can find in the official announcement.
[p align="justify"]We're really happy to see Steam introduce a feature like this, and naturally, we wanted to make use of it as soon as possible!
[p align="justify"]Happy hunting, Cleaners!

items.text: We’ve got something for all Crime Scene Cleaner music fans!

We’ve updated the official soundtrack with tracks introduced in our latest game updates (although "Other Girls" from LULU Suicide won't be released until May 8th). This expanded version brings in new pieces that better capture the atmosphere of the latest locations and moments in the game. Plus, they're just plain fun to listen to, right?
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153150/Crime_Scene_Cleaner_Soundtrack/"]

On top of that, the full soundtrack is now available on YouTube! You can listen to your favorite tracks anytime, anywhere. If you enjoyed the vibe of the music while cleaning… now you can take it anywhere with you :) You’ll also find additional details about specific tracks in the description section – our sound designer Matik often shares various bits of trivia and behind-the-scenes insights about how particular pieces were created. Check it out!

notes.title: Crime Scene Cleaner launches its first major update “Nightmare Update” July 24, 2025 on Steam!

items.text: The nightmares are getting worse. From twisted spaces to blood-soaked rooms, each scene feels like a descent into madness. It's your job to erase every trace – no matter how disturbing...

A big update is coming your way - available on Steam 24th July 2025. The Challenge Mode “Nightmare” update will contain whole 10 "Nightmare" versions of every currently existing map, featuring new mechanics and even more thrilling gameplay. Completing these special nightmare maps will reward you with unlockable cosmetics – special skins – so there’s plenty of incentive to push through the challenge!

Cleaning up after the mafia was never going to be without consequences. The blood, the bodies, the silence, it all left a mark. In the Nightmare Update Kovalsky is haunted by twisted versions of the crime scenes he once scrubbed clean. Nothing is as it was – and he’ll have to face them all over again.

Think you’ve mastered the art of cleaning? Think again. There’s a new True Cleaner Mode that strips away all the help – no hints, no cleaner’s instinct, no mercy. Just you, the filth, and your tools. It’s the ultimate challenge for those who believe they can handle the job without leaving a single trace.

Hello Cleaners!

It’s renovation time! Proper cleanup does not only mean collecting trash or washing up floors and walls. Once the mayhem of a crime happens, there will be some furniture you must move around. These could be a sign of struggle or victims’ attempts to hide.

At the beginning of some missions, you may receive photos which will guide you in cleaning up misplaced furniture. Miscellaneous things should be returned to their spots, so no one can even suspect that anything has happened before. Sometimes you will have to use your own imagination and cleaning sense to make sure everything is in the right spot.

Luckily, you don’t have to worry about perfectly recreating the pictures, coherent look is key. If you find random chairs in the middle of the room, make sure to find which table has an unfinished set. The same goes for other larger objects such as drawers or wardrobes. Every cabinet has to have a full set of drawers and stand in roughly the same place. So before you move on to another room, make sure everything is neat and as clean as possible.

Unfortunately, not every piece of furniture can be simply picked up and placed in its rightful spot. There are those which are too big to simply throw away, in that case, you will be forced to dismantle them into smaller pieces, so they can fit in your van more easily. Luckily you have your powerful fists! Break the old furniture to make space for potentially new! The house owner will thank you later! If they are still alive that is...

These small renovations may be some of the final things you do on the crime scene, so check every corner carefully before you leave. It would be unprofessional to leave the house you just spent time cleaning and renovating in a state of disarray. Hopefully, you enjoy a bit of house decor and macabre renovations. Let us know what you think about this element of cleaning up. We’re awaiting your feedback here in the comments, on our social media and in our discord.
See you next time!
